title: Hedge Iris董事：智谱估值87倍，目标价仅40美元
speaker: Felix Wong

segments.en: So Tsupu usually has been coined by many analysts as the anthropic of China. I'm not so sure about that. I think there are some similarities on B2B, but we're keeping an eye on what's happening with anthropic.
segments.zh: 许多分析师称智谱为中国的Anthropic。我不太确定。在B2B方面有一些相似之处，但我们正在关注Anthropic的情况。

segments.en: If you limit their best performing model, people are saying, well, that makes Tsupu a lot more competitive because they're almost as good as the most frontier models out there.
segments.zh: 如果限制其最佳模型，人们会说这使智谱更具竞争力，因为它们几乎与最前沿的模型一样好。

segments.en: So that's the alternative. So what I would say is the US government may be doing this to control distillation. So in the future, model releases, frontier model releases from both China and the US will probably slow down a lot because of these changes in distillation.
segments.zh: 所以这是一种替代方案。我认为美国政府可能是在控制蒸馏技术。未来，中美两国的前沿模型发布可能会因此大幅放缓。

segments.en: Okay. What does this mean for the stock feelings? Because the lock up period expires pretty soon for some of these stocks. How much selling pressure are you expecting now? And what is fair value you think for Jirupu now?
segments.zh: 这对市场情绪意味着什么？因为一些权益资产的锁定期即将到期。你预计会有多大的抛售压力？你认为智谱的公允价值是多少？

segments.en: So my fair value is actually only around $407. The way I reach there is if you put a 15 times EV.AR multiple on 2028 numbers or 20 times EV.
segments.zh: 我的公允价值实际上只有大约40美元。我是通过给2028年数据15倍EV/AR或20倍EV得出的。

segments.en: The sales figure for 2028. Why am I using these numbers? Again, I'm using an anthropic and open AI as sort of a guide on what is reasonable valuation for pure model, pure LL model company.
segments.zh: 2028年的营收数据。为什么用这些数字？我以Anthropic和OpenAI作为纯LLM公司合理估值的参考。

segments.en: Now put this into perspective and anthropic, trailing valuation for EV, the AR is right now 21 times, Jirupu is trading at 87 times EV, the AR.
segments.zh: 对比来看，Anthropic的EV/AR倍数是21倍，而智谱是87倍。
